Introduced in PTX ISA version 1.0.

reason_for_inclusion: Semantics line of the general predication form: 'If {!}p then instruction' (the instruction executes when the guard holds; combined with the do-nothing clause in PTX-9.3-MOV-035 this is the guard-true/guard-false pair). PTX ISA Notes (introduced 1.0) and Target ISA Notes (supported on all target architectures) accompany the general @ form.
